items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: I tell you who was in the band, Frankie Newton was in the band after that.

ctx.x: here in - no, in New York, in, and I did the same thing. But if I - I was drinking too - but I didn't fall off or nothing. I tell you who was in the band, Frankie Newton was in the band after that. So I was makin' these little [ ] that I used to play, and I, at that time the people make high notes, you know. And I was saying "Dah", and they build it up that way, "Dah". And every time I'd make higher I'd go back, you know what I mean? That, it was - so when I made the climax of the note I fell right down again,…
